⚡ Quick Wins — Execute This Week, Zero Cost
🏆 Launch SP RB Clearance Competition 🛒 Re-display RB Items at Branch Floor Level 📱 WhatsApp Flash Sale — SP sends Monday 9AM
🏷️
Traditional
Battle-tested — execute with confidence
1
SP RB Clearance Competition
Monthly leaderboard: the SP who clears the highest RB Cost earns a bonus commission multiplier. This dashboard already tracks it — publish the rankings weekly and make it visible to the whole team.
📌 Sales Manager ⚡ This Week
2
Tiered Markdown by Aging Months
Automate markdown from AGING data: 3–4 months → 10% off cost; 5–6 months → 20% off; 7+ months → 30% off. SP requests approval per SKU — no blanket cuts, controlled margin impact.
📌 SC Planning + Sales 📅 This Month
3
Fast + Slow SKU Bundling
Pair every RB unit with 1–2 fast-moving accessories (mats, resistance bands, bottles). Offer the bundle at 8% overall saving. Customer perceives value — you move stuck units with minimal margin sacrifice.
📌 Each SP ⚡ This Week
4
BNPL / Installment Financing
Enable 0% 3-month installments on RB items above SAR 3,000 via Tamara, Tabby, or Cashew. Reduces psychological barrier to buying high-ticket equipment — which represent the largest share of RB cost.
📌 Finance + Sales 📅 This Month
5
Re-Display at Branch Floor Level
Move RB items from storage and back-of-house to prime floor positions at every branch today. Items not visible are items not sold. Zero cost, immediate impact — brief branch managers this week.
📌 Branch Managers ⚡ This Week
6
Supplier Buyback Negotiation
Use the AGING data as hard evidence to negotiate buyback credits or swap deals for items approaching 6+ months. Show suppliers the SAR value and aging chart — most will negotiate to protect the commercial relationship.
📌 SC Planning + Procurement 🗓 This Quarter
7
Trade-In / Part-Exchange Program
Offer existing gym owners a trade-in credit for their old equipment when upgrading. SP takes the old unit (refurbish or scrap), customer buys a new RB SKU. Drives upgrades and clears stock simultaneously.
📌 SP + Sales Manager 📅 This Month
💡
Creative
Unconventional channels — high upside potential
1
Corporate Wellness Gym Packages
Vision 2030's Wellbeing pillar drives corporate wellness mandates. Package 5–8 RB items as a "Complete Office Gym Setup" for companies with 50+ employees. Target HR directors — one deal can clear multiple SKUs in a single PO.
📌 B2B Sales Manager 📅 This Month
2
Hotel & Hospitality Gym Retrofit
KSA's tourism mega-projects (NEOM, Red Sea, Diriyah, Qiddiya) require hotel gym fitouts. Approach hotel procurement managers with a "Ready-to-Install Hotel Gym Bundle" from RB stock at project pricing — no haggling, just speed to delivery.
📌 B2B Sales 🗓 This Quarter
3
Real Estate Developer Tie-up
ROSHN, Dar Al Arkan, and EMAAR build thousands of residential units requiring gym amenities. Approach compound FM managers to supply RB items as standard amenity equipment for upcoming phases — a recurring volume contract with predictable pull-through.
📌 Sales Manager + Commercial 🗓 This Quarter
4
WhatsApp 48h Flash Sales
Every Monday 9AM, each SP sends their top 3 RB items with exclusive 48-hour pricing to their personal customer contact list. No public price change, no brand erosion — pure urgency-driven, relationship-based selling at zero marketing cost.
📌 Each SP ⚡ This Week
5
National Day & Seasonal Bundles
Package 3–4 RB items as "National Day 23 Sept Fitness Pack" or "Ramadan Home Gym Bundle" at a named promotional price. Seasonal context creates urgency and justifies a limited offer without cheapening the Delta brand identity.
📌 Marketing + Sales 📅 Per Calendar
6
Cross-Branch Redistribution First
Before discounting anything — check first: an item stuck at one branch may be a fast-mover at another due to different demographics or floor space. Use the Location tab to spot the gaps. Redistribute before marking down — free money left on the table.
📌 SC Planning 📅 This Month
7
Certified Showroom Condition Program
Relabel aged floor stock and display units as "Certified Showroom — Full Delta Warranty" at 10–15% off. A buyer perceives a deal, not a clearance sale. Repackage with a Delta quality inspection tag and brief SPs on the value story.
📌 Branch Manager + Marketing 📅 This Month
🚀
Out-of-the-Box
Think beyond the showroom floor
1
Government & Ministry Sport Tenders
SRSA (Saudi Sports for All Federation), Ministry of Sport, and municipalities operate hundreds of public fitness centers. Register Delta as an approved vendor and bid RB stock competitively. One government tender = 20–50 units cleared in a single transaction.
📌 Commercial + Sales Manager 🗓 This Quarter
2
Ministry of Education School Program
MoE's PE curriculum expansion needs gym equipment in schools and universities nationwide. Create a "School Gym Starter Kit" at edu-pricing using 4–5 RB items. One MoE framework agreement can become a national rollout across hundreds of institutions.
📌 Commercial 🗓 This Quarter
3
Insurance Wellness Partnership
BUPA Arabia, Tawuniya, and MedGulf have corporate wellness KPI obligations under CCHI regulations. Propose Delta as their preferred gym equipment supplier for employee wellness initiatives at corporate client sites — co-branded as a benefit, not a catalogue sale.
📌 Sales Manager + Marketing 🗓 This Quarter
4
Micro-Gym Entrepreneur Packages
Home gyms and micro-gyms (under 200 sqm) are booming across KSA. Create a "Launch Your Gym — SAR 12,000" starter package with 4–5 RB items including delivery and installation. Target first-time operators via Instagram and Snapchat geo-targeted ads in Riyadh and Jeddah.
📌 Marketing + SP 📅 This Month
5
GCC Secondary Market Export
Items with zero velocity in KSA may have active buyers in Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Bahrain, or Kuwait. Identify the top 5 stuck SKUs and approach local distributors in those markets for a one-time bulk deal at cost + 5%. Any margin beats a writedown.
📌 Procurement + Commercial 🗓 This Quarter
6
VIP Exclusive Clearance Event
Invite Delta's top 50–100 customers by purchase history to a private invitation-only event: 25–35% off selected RB items — no public announcement. Exclusivity creates urgency; the existing relationship enables close-the-deal selling without pressure.
📌 Sales Manager + SP 📅 This Month
7
Equipment Rental for Clinics & Academies
Physical therapy clinics, sports academies, and rehab centers often cannot afford outright purchase. Offer RB items on 12-month rental contracts (monthly SAR fee). Items leave inventory books, generate recurring revenue, and can be sold to the renter at term end.
📌 Finance + Sales 🗓 This Quarter
